cues: Short urban trips become cheaper when commuters replace engine-powered rides with quiet, leg-driven travel.
Regular journeys under pedal power build stamina while helping travelers reach work, shops, and school.
Protected lanes give low-speed travelers safer routes through busy neighborhoods without competing directly with cars.
Children gain confidence and balance while learning to propel themselves around parks and quiet streets.
Deliveries can move through congested city centers efficiently, avoiding parking delays and reducing local exhaust.
Weekend outings let families explore nearby trails together while enjoying fresh air and modest exercise.
